entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The one known remaining city on the plane of Capenna, a metropolis of steel and chrome ruled by five crime families and dependent on Halo.

entities.name: Capenna
entities.description: The plane on which New Capenna stands, desolate outside the city.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: The essence of the angels, used as healing elixir, for teleportation and to enhance spells; produced from trapped angels' bodies.

entities.name: Archangels
entities.description: The angels of Capenna who defended the plane and were trapped by the demons to become Halo.

entities.name: Archdemons
entities.description: The demon lords who made a deal with the archangels, appointed the five families and betrayed the angels.

entities.name: Five Families
entities.description: The five ruling crime families of New Capenna: Obscura, Maestros, Riveteers, Cabaretti and Brokers.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: A family of gifted magicians.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: The elite assassins of New Capenna.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A family of destruction workers who control the Caldaia.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: A family of party monsters.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: The demonic lawyers of the crime world who ruled Park Heights.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders whose attack made the plane's situation dire and who invaded again under Atraxa.

entities.name: Ziatora
entities.description: Led the laborers who finished building the city and directed the Caldaia's redesign.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Planeswalker who lived on the plane for weeks without learning the name of its government.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: Planeswalker who infiltrated the plane and struck at the families' leadership on the night of the Crescendo.

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: A family boss killed in Ob Nixilis's strike.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: A boss seriously wounded in the strike.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: Possibly the last free angel in the city, whose sacrifice began the angels' reawakening.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Phyrexian sent by Elesh Norn with ten thousand soldiers to destroy New Capenna and its Halo.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian leader who sent Atraxa.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: Leader of the Maestros, compleated by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian leader whose death on Dominaria likely caused the slumber of the Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The rich upper borough of New Capenna, destroyed to defeat the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Errant
entities.description: Credited with destroying Park Heights to defeat the invaders.

entities.name: Operation Falling Star
entities.description: The counterattack that dropped Park Heights on Atraxa.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: The industrial lowest tier of New Capenna and territory of the Riveteers.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The middle tier of New Capenna, its cultural and commercial hub.

events.summary: After the Phyrexian attack, archangels and demonlords strike an unlikely deal that creates the metropolis of New Capenna.
events.quote: An unlikely deal between arch angels and demonlords created the metropolis of New Capenna.

events.summary: The archdemons appoint five families to rule the city and confer demon status on each family head.
events.quote: the archdemons appointed five families to rule the city in their name

events.summary: The last elevator arrives and New Capenna is sealed to all below after the final battle.
events.quote: The enemy rebuffed, the last elevator arrived, and New Capenna was sealed to all below.

events.summary: The archdemons plot to trap the angels and distribute their essence across the city.
events.quote: trap the angels, and let an age of demons begin

events.summary: Taking advantage of a Phyrexian slumber, the archdemons and the five capture the archangels during a victory celebration, converting their bodies into Halo.
events.quote: the five captured the archangels and their hosts during a city-wide celebration of victory

events.summary: The Demon Lords use the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappear.
events.quote: The Demon Lords used the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappeared themselves.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis infiltrates the plane and strikes the families' leadership on the night of the Crescendo; Xander is killed and Jetmir wounded.
events.quote: At least one boss, Xander , was killed, with Jetmir seriously wounded.

events.summary: After Giada's sacrifice, the city's other angels begin reawakening from stasis.
events.quote: the city's other angels began reawakening from their stasis

events.summary: Atraxa and ten thousand soldiers invade; the Phyrexians compleat the Maestros' leadership including Anhelo.
events.quote: The Phyrexians compleated the Maestros' leadership, including Anhelo .

events.summary: A resistance of families and awakened angels counterattacks, dropping Park Heights on Atraxa in Operation Falling Star.
events.quote: dropping the neighborhood on Atraxa and turning the tide against the invaders

events.summary: The angels leave to fight Phyrexians on other planes and cannot return after New Phyrexia's multiversal switch.
events.quote: those who traveled to the plane could not return after its multiversal switch

events.summary: The remaining angels turn on their captors and betrayers, the demons.
events.quote: turned their focus on their captors and betrayers, the demons

relations.note: The one known remaining city on the plane.
relations.quote: the one known remaining city on the plane of Capenna

relations.note: The demons betrayed and trapped the angels.
relations.quote: while the archangels puzzled, the archdemons of Capenna plotted

relations.note: Sent by Norn to destroy New Capenna.
relations.quote: Atraxa was sent with ten thousand soldiers by Elesh Norn
It was ruled by the Brokers

relations.note: Siphoned members and struck at leadership.
relations.quote: siphoning members of each of the families and hosting a targeted strike on their leadership
